acceptance.qualification: Historical native CRUD/exact restoration passed on fe124f61. Product 5d6c8e55 passed seven isolated cases, three read-only account/worker cases in the real UI process (including a scheduled PasswordSyncWorker completing), and no-lock manager account listing through native input with no secret inputs and FLAG_SECURE retained. Early background/reopen checks timed out without input reaching the manager. Focused fixture db090afa passed the real Settings/task-switch, grant clearing, explicit reopening and recreation case in 6.801 seconds on the identical 5d6c8e55 product APK after test-only stable-focus synchronization; no product access/overlay protection changed. Provider/configured-lock and wider background/recovery acceptance remain open. Host proof is 33 password-sync and 41 Core cases. Original Services cf93b15 was restored without clearing data and test APKs removed after each completed run; final live readback matched the original APK bytes.
acceptance.registrationQualification: Source 22be48a1: 42 password-sync and 41 Core host tests; matching-signer device 7 isolated + 5 native registration/read/worker/scheduler + 1 manager-listing cases passed. Identical scheduler fixture reproduced dropped follow-up work on product 5d6c8e55 and passed on 22be48a1. Two registered-token synthetic CRUD/exact-restoration cases also passed (16.425 seconds); unrelated records checked. Original Services cf93b15 bytes restored, no data clearing, temporary instrumentation removed. Actual push delivery, token-invalid/reboot/reconnect and official producer interoperability remain unaccepted.
acceptance.managementQualification: Product 2756e591, fixture 6dcec757: guarded recovery restored the exact synthetic payload and cleared its journal (6.232 seconds); all three manager cases passed (23.47 seconds), including native-input name/note save, secure-dialog callback, metadata search and lifecycle. Google retained omitted notes backup10 during an earlier restore update; explicitly authorized synthetic delete/re-create restored the original bytes. Unrelated data checked; original Services restored and test package removed. Explicit note deletion/GetPassword acceptance pending. Host validation has passed 57 sync + 41 Core cases.
acceptance.pushQualification: Real server-push check on product 2756e591 timed out in a bounded observation window (97.123 seconds total). FCM capability existed but the required actual password-push generation and authenticated cache readback were not observed. Synthetic data and original Services restored. Read-only connection/delivery instrumentation is being added; realPushAccepted remains false.
